description.en:
Sets the boots and gloves used by a whole match team (not by a single player). Both are stored in the team's match setup.
The story match scripts call it at the top of InitBtl, before adding their players.
Team: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Boots item ID, e.g. "ssa0001", or its CRC32 hash as an integer.

Gloves item ID, e.g. "sga0001", or its CRC32 hash as an integer.
The native only checks for 2 arguments but always reads this one, so pass it.

true once the call has run.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Equipping the player's team at match setup (real usage, from btl0002.nut)
